title: ASSIGNMENT – 8
subtitle: Web Crawler for Automated Web Content Discovery
name: Srikrishna O S

sections.heading: AIM
sections.paragraph: To implement a web crawler using Spring Boot for automated discovery and retrieval of web content, manage the URL queue efficiently, avoid repeated crawling through a visited-URL set, integrate Redis for state management, expose the crawler through REST APIs, deploy with Docker, and analyse performance under concurrent workloads using JMeter.

plots.caption: Web crawler workflow: seed URL, queue, visited check, page retrieval, hyperlink extraction, and Redis state update
Docker Compose: building and starting web-crawler and Redis containers
Spring Boot application starting on port 8080
Maven test execution and crawler test result summary
Postman: POST /api/crawl request and JSON response
Redis CLI: inspecting crawler queue, visited set, and crawl status

rows: Spring Boot service with BFS queue, visited set, link extraction, and Redis persistence
Redis List (LPUSH/RPOP) for FIFO enqueue/dequeue of crawl URLs
Redis Set (SADD/SISMEMBER) for O(1) duplicate detection
Redis String stores JSON PageCrawlResult with title, links, status, timestamp
Endpoints for start, stop, status, visited, queue, results, reset, health
Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml builds Spring Boot app with Redis container
Explained roles of seed URL, URL queue, visited set, Redis cache, and queue vs scan comparison
The starting point pushed onto the queue; anchors the same-domain filter
FIFO Redis List that decouples discovery from processing and feeds worker threads
Redis Set giving O(1) duplicate check, preventing infinite loops and redundant fetches
Fetches pages with Jsoup, extracts a[href] links, validates/normalizes them, and enqueues new ones
Stores queue, visited set, page metadata JSON, and atomic counters for durable, shareable state
Jsoup selects a[href], resolves absolute URLs, and filters by scheme/host/extension/domain/depth
Added to visited set, fetched, parsed, stored as PageCrawlResult, and linked pages enqueued
Mark attempt returns false; the URL is skipped immediately without re-fetching
Queue: O(1) enqueue/dequeue and O(n) total work. Scanning: O(n) per lookup, O(n^2) overall
50 concurrent users submit /start requests. Asynchronous crawling queues work in Redis; throughput stays stable

sections.heading: LEARNING OUTCOMES
bullets: Developed a web crawler using Spring Boot
Implemented automated URL discovery and crawling using a URL queue
Managed visited URLs to prevent duplicate crawling
Integrated Redis for managing or caching crawling state
Exposed and tested web crawler functionality through REST APIs
Deployed the web crawler and Redis using Docker
Analysed the performance and scalability of the web crawler under concurrent workloads
